items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Well, Chris Kelly, he was another good player, but I didn't know him too much.

ctx.x: Did you ever know which bands played there? Did Sidney Desvina, I know, played there for a while?

Yeah, yeah. Yeah, they played there. Any other bands that you know of? Yeah, Sidney played there. Buddy Petit played there plenty too. Yeah, Buddy Petit played there plenty. What was he like? Did you know Buddy very well? Buddy Petit? Well, I knew him. He was a little older than me, but I had a bum with him, but I knew him. Yeah. About going to the dances and things. What did he look like? Little brown-skinned fella. Short brown-skinned fella. What about Chris Kelly? Well, Chris Kelly, he was another good player,…
But what happened at first in the Bonkays? Well, it'd be a Society. No, I mean when you first come to it,

items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-30
items.q: Chris Kelly, one of the wonderful conness players, used to play at the Poise Brennan Hall.

ctx.x: Bill, what's your name? Bill Russell again. Okay, let's see. You made up a list of questions I got it right here. Okay, let's see. You got something here about the two step on the question.

Oh, the first step is here about the musician. Oh, Chris Kelly? Yeah, Chris Kelly, one of the wonderful conness players, used to play at the Poise Brennan Hall. Come from down the country, which is which is, which is, which is down volley. And he made his home up here in the city. Used to play music at the Poise Brennan Hall. One of the people would yell, tell us they're playing at a concert, and come up there, and everybody looks for him, and they come to the concert, and they yell about the name of the band,…
Were those bands, like one will be in one hall and one will be with another, will they try to empty the other hall?
